reviews.title: Amazing tools
reviews.body: I'm a bit of an old dog not too keen on new tricks. I've been a professional woodworker for over 40 years. When I first saw these oscillating tools, I thought they were gimmicky and a bit silly. One of my employees had one out on a job site, and he mentioned how handy they were a few times, and I blew it off. As the day progressed, I saw him use it a half a dozen times, and finally I was in a position where my available tools weren't quite "right" so I said "Darn you! let me borrow your oscillating tool" (ok maybe not in those exact words. I was awakened to its versatility. My only complaint is the star lock backing me into a corner of expensive blades, but I've got a dozen Bosch tools, and I didn't want to introduce a new battery system to my tool chest. Other than that, it's a well built heavy duty oscillating tool. And my employee is envious how easy the star lock blades go on and off so I can't complain too much.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on August 22, 2023
reviews.author: Alan T.

reviews.title: New battery packs rattle in this tool.
reviews.body: My only gripe with this tool is that newest generation Bosch battery packs do not seat perfectly in this tool. They click in, and power the tool just fine, but they rattle loudly when the tool is in use. I reserve a couple of my older generation 4AH packs for use with it. The older generation battery packs fit perfectly and do not rattle. Other than that, this is an excellent cordless OMT. It has a slightly smaller arc of oscillation than corded OMTs like the Fein, but that is actually an advantage in many situations. The smaller arc makes for smoother action, albeit a slightly slower cut. In a lot of situations this gives you more control and less jumpiness in some materials. This tool is much nicer than the comparable cordless OMTs from other brands. The only one nicer than the Bosch is probably the Fein. This feels as rugged and smooth as a corded tool!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 19, 2021
reviews.author: Kevin G. Dodds

reviews.title: It's in the details
reviews.body: This is not a coarse weapon, i use it only for detail work close to edges or in tight spaces, works perfectly and as for battery life i can't compare it to any other 18v tool, cause why would I own two? Good enough for me and i get about 30-40 of cutting spruce with a6mah battery. Looks great and fits the storage system perfectly. Carbide blades will cost you though, and you want those.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 31, 2022
reviews.author: Emil Fernquist

reviews.title: Great tool as usual from Bosch
reviews.body: I really like the Startlock system.  Takes 5 seconds to remove and replace a blade.  I've used other oscillating tools and replacing blades without StarLock is tedious. This uses the same battery as my drill and impact.  I've used it to cut nails, wood, and PVC pipe.  Cuts all of it like butter, but the metal blades do wear out quickly.  It also doesn't seem to use the battery very quickly.As always I highly recommend Bosch tools and this tool is no exception.  Works like it should and gets the job done quickly.  I haven't even needed to turn it too full speed.  I had zero hesitation in buying this and I'm pleased with the purchase

features: STARLOCK 3-D TOOL-ACCESSORY INTERFACE: Delivers three-dimensional blade grip for more torque transfer
MULTI-TOOL VERSATILITY: Accomplish flush-cutting, plunge-cutting, sanding, grinding, and many other tasks
DYNAMIC ACCESSORY RANGE: Utilizes all starlock and starlockplus accessories
CORDED-LIKE PERFORMANCE: Power and speed comparable to the corded bosch gop40-30 starlockplus oscillating tool
EC BRUSHLESS MOTOR TECHNOLOGY: Offers better efficiency than previous-generation 18v motors for increased runtime and exceptional motor life in an ultra-compact design
WIDE 2.8 OSCILLATING ARC: Provides better accessory utilization and increased productivity
SNAP-IN TOOLLESS ACCESSORY ATTACHMENT AND RELEASE LEVER: Allows for no-touch, easy release of blade; no more burned fingers
LED LIGHT: For illumination in dark work areas
FLUSH-CUTTING DESIGN: Built to accomplish flush cuts such as doorjambs cuts using various plunge or segment blades
CONSTANT RESPONSE CIRCUITRY: Maintains the desired speed under load
